feature: Toppan: kendaraan asing (F) tanpa PS-FOR aktif dikeluarkan dari pembuatan surat dan PS-FOR dipasang ulang otomatis saat letter generation
note: Ditemukan saat trace OCMS11.12. Di getValidOffenceNoticesOptimized, notice vehicle_registration_type F yang belum dibayar dan tanpa PS-FOR aktif dilewati dari file surat lalu applyPsSuspensionForForeignVehicles memasang PS-FOR lagi. Tidak ada story di chunk ini yang menamai perilaku ini; mungkin dicakup story suspension epic lain.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS11.12. In getValidOffenceNoticesOptimized, unpaid notices with vehicle_registration_type F and no active PS-FOR are left out of the letter file and applyPsSuspensionForForeignVehicles re-applies PS-FOR. No story in this chunk names this behaviour; it may be covered by a suspension story in another epic.

feature: Toppan Upload day-end: SMS alert status job ke nomor ops lewat JobSmsAlertHelper
note: Ditemukan saat trace OCMS11.12. ToppanUploadJobsScheduler memanggil jobSmsAlertHelper.sendAlert setelah job day-end (properti cron.sms.alert.enabled=true dan penerima di application-prod.properties:89-90). Terkait ticket OCMS-SR-2026-041 (Closed, Prod deployed). Tidak ada story di chunk ini yang menamai alert ini.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS11.12. ToppanUploadJobsScheduler calls jobSmsAlertHelper.sendAlert after the day-end job (property cron.sms.alert.enabled=true and recipients in application-prod.properties:89-90). Related to ticket OCMS-SR-2026-041 (Closed, Prod deployed). No story in this chunk names this alert.
